test_title: PYST 37: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All desks are pens.

Some pens are clips.

No clip is a book.

**Conclusions:**

I. All pens are desks.

II. Some books are not clips.

III. All pens are clips.
solution:
**The least possible venn diagram : **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d75a0057c1d4e8b062408b149962749664e9e361a8b8598f87a69a774b83d0a2.png] 

Conclusion :

I. All pens are desks. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e95ba04a93bf6cfca8785bf502822ce56735adbf89f08b8b76caf68836385350.png] False ( because all desk are pens as shown above )

II. Some books are not clips. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e95ba04a93bf6cfca8785bf502822ce56735adbf89f08b8b76caf68836385350.png] True ( because no clip is a book )

III. All pens are clips. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e95ba04a93bf6cfca8785bf502822ce56735adbf89f08b8b76caf68836385350.png] False ( as their is no definite relation between them )

Hence, **Option 4** is the correct answer.
